[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Galaxian & Cost 3 or more) (Rebirth Nexus)]
◆When you summon/advent/deploy a target Spirit/Nexus, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same name as this Nexus, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Put a card from your Hand to the Removed Zone. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Spirit with the same color as the card being put.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Pay one cost to summon a "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Galaxian" family Spirit card from your Removed Zone.
